Subsequently, similar laws were adopted by princely states, leading to a general ban for all of India issued by Queen Victoria in 1861 (Document [1]).
*   **Long-term Impact:** The practice was eventually criminalized further with the Indian Sati Prevention Act of 1988, which penalized aiding, abetting, or glorifying sati (Document [1]).
